research.text: His group employs integrated photonics, optical frequency combs, and nonlinear optics to solve pressing problems in quantum information science, molecular spectroscopy, and quantum sensing. With these unique tools the group can produce powerful, agile optical frequency combs in the near-infrared and then spectrally translate them to critical wavelengths in the visible for quantum science or the mid-infrared for molecular sensing and dynamics. Further, the group’s recent advancements in thin-film lithium niobate electro-optic modulators and optical isolators will allow us to produce chip-scale platforms for integrated quantum sensing and communications with low size, weight, and power. Future efforts will aim to apply these capabilities for mid-infrared sensing of highly dynamic environments as well as to produce fully integrated platforms for quantum science and multiplexed quantum state
